steps.name: Set up job
Check out HeptaTorch
Check out the pinned HIA toolchain sources
Check out the fixed historical legacy-compiler witness
Check that the complete upstream target remains recorded
Bootstrap and reproduce the native HIA compiler
Expand and reproduce the HIA compiler capacity profile
Verify the pinned module adaptation inputs
Author and reproduce three native module-compiler generations
Compile and natively link the complete current runtime as modules
Exercise native module contracts, alias lifetimes and guarded ABI
Build and test native-linked and monolithic HIA runtimes
Reproduce native session flat linker and wide packer
Qualify flat linking and actual native session capacity
Build and independently exercise both interactive session runtimes
Reproduce the owned-resource ABI2 compiler and native syscall allocator
Qualify native owner transfer, release, refusal and runtime equivalence
Reproduce checked owned-state interactive entry and cleanup tools
Build and qualify growable owned storage and independent reference model
Build and qualify paged owned Tensor execution and real growth
Install the independent pinned PyTorch CPU oracle
Observe pinned PyTorch alpha rounding semantics
Observe pinned PyTorch layout-selection semantics
Compare native-linked HIA with pinned real PyTorch (270 cases)
Compare monolithic HIA with pinned real PyTorch (270 cases)
Summarize both current PyTorch oracle builds without changing historical receipts
Compare modular interactive sessions with pinned real PyTorch (21 cases)
Compare monolithic interactive sessions with pinned real PyTorch (21 cases)
Bind both interactive PyTorch session reports to exact native sources
Observe pinned PyTorch indexed-accumulation boundary semantics
Observe pinned PyTorch empty-tensor metadata
Compare owned Tensor execution and absolute parameter versions with pinned PyTorch
Post Check out the fixed historical legacy-compiler witness
Post Check out the pinned HIA toolchain sources
Post Check out HeptaTorch
Complete job

independent.reference: Exact rational nonuniform VJP plus separate unchanged canonical native execution

native_report.scope: CPU binary32 numerical Tensor/AD/optimizer execution across genuinely owned allocation and descriptor growth; the strict pinned PyTorch counter gate is separate.

strict_pytorch_report.scope: CPU binary32 rank 0..4, paged offset arena and real owned interactive state. No claim that independent Storage/Version objects or all PyTorch are integrated.

release_source_equivalence.change: The release commit adds five lines under [tool.ruff], setting target-version to py310 with explanatory comments. There are no deletions. Every other root entry and every source subtree is identical.
release_source_equivalence.scope: Only this exact official wheel SHA256/build commit and this exact inventory release commit. This is source equivalence for the recorded lint-only release change, not identity of the two Git commits or an allowance for other builds.

version_observation.scope: Exact absolute initial counters and one explicit shared write, with independent clone.
version_observation.profile: owned Tensor v2; former protocol remains separately qualified
